raw_record_integrity.evidence: Pinned full archives, exact record lengths and CRC-checked streaming reads.

retained_trial_enumeration.evidence: 107109596 contiguous raw sync intervals per side; every setting and archived word reconciled, all prefixes/suffixes explicit.

complete_physical_acquisition.evidence: Sync enumeration does not establish that hardware never omitted an entire physical trial or failed to record an event.

local_binary_outcome.evidence: Raw bitwise OR within fixed pulse/phase windows; no coincidence conditioning; no-click rows retained.

timestamp_excursions.evidence: Paired jump spans and ambiguous settings enter as arbitrary scores on known row slots; 19968 rows.

physical_cross_site_alignment.evidence: Archive offsets absent; local sequence fingerprints recover stored pairing but not a GPS/propagation certificate.

spacelike_endpoint_calibration.evidence: Published experiment describes spacetime geometry; no run-specific calibrated support/tail budget transported into this audit.

causal_assignment_exogeneity.evidence: Required relative to device history and potential receiver outcomes; cannot follow from observed setting balance.

history_conditional_joint_setting_tv.evidence: Assumed scenario grid. v2 requires a uniform per-history TV cap; v1 permits an average cap. Published Bell excess predictability and empirical setting balance do not establish either premise.

ordinary_leakage_transport.evidence: No calibrated bound on history-conditional or realized-average nuisance shift for these records.

retrospective_endpoint_selection.evidence: v1 summable union over starts/lengths; v2 Ville bounds over endpoints plus summable starts and finite event/window/lambda family. Neither covers outcome-tuned pairing or undeclared window searches.

outcome_rule_adaptedness.evidence: Fixed pulse rules are explicit, but the archive does not establish that its phase calibration was selected independently of all scored outcomes. Endpoint uniformity does not cover arbitrary retrospective outcome-rule search.

recorded_event_support.evidence: Event-supported v2 assumes complete detector recording within each retained sync interval, reliable record ordering and binary latent settings consistent with unambiguous stored codes. No channel-0 record then implies no eligible click. Timestamp uncertainty may change phase eligibility but not move events between sync intervals. Not a hardware completeness certificate; unrestricted envelope also reported.
